title: Understanding Regularization
text: Regularization is a technique used to prevent overfitting by adding a penalty to the loss function. In L2 regularization, this penalty is proportional to the square of the magnitude of the coefficients. What effect do you think this has on the coefficients when the regularization parameter lambda is large?

title: Effect of Large Lambda
text: When lambda is set to a large value, the regularization term heavily penalizes large coefficients. This tends to shrink the coefficients towards zero. How might this affect the slope of the decision boundary?

title: Analyzing Decision Boundaries
text: Consider how a large lambda affects the decision boundary. Which figure shows a decision boundary that is more vertical, indicating a smaller coefficient for SadEmojiCount?
